messages:
Maria (Marketing): Quick sync — want to nail the launch narrative for our speed vs spend story. short hook for blog + 3 visuals for the webinar. ideas?
Aj: Love it. thinking: 1) median vs tail latency on same x-axis 2) tokens/$ curve per model family 3) routing decision flow (fast path vs cost path). simple, CTA: try a demo.
Kevin: +1. For copy, emphasize predictable inference economics for engineering teams. not just 'faster' — 'predictable cost at scale'.
Sophia: Can we show a tiny customer example? e.g., a helpdesk assistant with 500 qps -> how sosts change with batching and cache. one chart showing cost before/after optimize.
Tim: I sketched a layout: left = latency violin (median + 95th), center = tokens-per-dollar scatter with linear fit, right = Sankey for request routing percentages and effective $/req.
Olivia: For the tokens/$ scatter — can we overlay lines for quantized vs fp16? helps position Dedicated/private options.
Maria (Marketing): yes. keep color palette simple (brand blues + gray). copy bullets: 1. predictable per-request economics 2. graceful fallbacks to keep SLAs 3. ops controls to tune cost/latency. Short headline ideas: "Speed you can predict. Cost you can control." Thoughts?
Aj: Headline good. Alternative: "Fast where it matters, cheap where it doesn't." more punchy.
Kevin: Maybe avoid 'cheap'. use 'efficient' instead. "Fast where it matters, efficient where it doesn't."
BenchBot: Chart upload: https://internal.artifacts/figs/speed-vs-spend_v1.png
Sophia: Uploaded sample numbers for demo. CSV: 
```
scenario,requests_per_min,avg_latency_ms,tokens_per_req,cost_per_1M_tokens_usd
baseline,30000,250,120,20
with_batching,30000,180,120,12
with_cache,30000,90,120,8
```
Tim: Nice. Can we add a microcopy line under charts: "Assumes model: open-32k-quantized on A100-class" so folks understand setup.
Olivia: Also need a single slide that maps inbound routing -> lead qualification: e.g., enterprise demo leads go to sales, dev trials get self-serve flows. short wire copy for CTA.
Maria (Marketing): ok action list: 1) Tim — make draft panels (due EOD Thu) 2) Sophia — produce cost/data table + small narrative (due Thu) 3) Kevin — draft 2 hero headlines + 3 alt CTAs (tomorrow) 4) Aj — webinar talking points and demo script (next Tue) 5) Olivia — inbound routing wire and suggested form fields.
Aj: Noted. I'll include a 5-min live demo route showing routing fallback (fast path -> fallback model) and a 2-slide explainer on unit economics.
Kevin: I'll avoid 'cheap' word. will A/B test both headlines in email subject.
Sophia: I'll add a tiny sensitivity table for token length distribution impact.
Maria (Marketing): Great. @BenchBot can you pin the fig link to the thread? :thumbsup:
BenchBot: Pinned <https://internal.artifacts/figs/speed-vs-spend_v1.png> to channel.
Tim: One small ask — can marketing ops add tracking param to demo link so we can capture which visual drove signups? e.g., ?utm_visual=violin_vs_scatter.
Olivia: I'll do that and sketch the lead routing spreadsheet.
Maria (Marketing): Excellent. If we all hit the deliverables we can freeze slides by Fri afternoon and aim Tuesday webinar. quick thumbs if you're aligned.
Aj: :thumbsup:
Kevin: :thumbsup:
Sophia: :thumbsup:
Tim: :thumbsup:
Olivia: :thumbsup:
